sandbachFocus: League leaders Sandbach United host Alsager Town on Saturday at 15:00, seeking to bounce back from their most recent loss. Sandbach remain top of the table with 22 points from 10 games despite that defeat, and face an Alsager side languishing near the foot of the division with just 4 points from 10 matches. This should present an opportunity for the leaders to reassert themselves after a rare slip.
divisionWide: Second-placed Stafford Town travel to Dawley Town on Saturday in a fixture between two mid-table sides, with Stafford looking to close the gap on leaders Sandbach after their own recent loss. AFC Bridgnorth host Eccleshall in a meeting of two strong performers—Bridgnorth are third with 19 points and recent form showing two losses followed by four wins, while Eccleshall sit fifth and have won their last two. Wolverhampton Casuals, fourth with 19 points, host bottom-placed Widnes Town (2 points, six consecutive defeats) in what should be a comfortable home fixture. Foley Meir host struggling Bilston Town—though Bilston currently sit sixth with 17 points, Foley Meir will look to end recent poor form (two losses in their last three). Shawbury United, winless in their last five, host Barnton, who are mid-table on 15 points. Market Drayton Town travel to New Mills in a clash between two sides in mid-table limbo. Brereton Social host Widnes Town on Saturday; Brereton have won just one of their last three and Widnes are in freefall. Cheadle Heath Nomads visit Telford Town in a fixture between two of the division's weakest performers. Crewe host Allscott Heath in a match between two sides struggling mid-table. Wednesfield Community visit Wolverhampton Casuals in a midweek derby on Wednesday 7 October at 19:45.
